title: release-kit project config
description: Per-project bindings for the git-release skill. Lives at <repo>/.claude/release-kit.json.

prCli.description: CLI used to open and merge the release/hotfix PR or MR.

devBranch.description: Integration branch releases are cut from.

versioningNote.description: One line describing how the version is derived (echoed in summaries). e.g. 'backend via MinVer (git tag); frontend/package.json is not touched'.

frontendVersionFile.description: Path (repo-relative) to a package.json whose "version" field must be bumped to match the tag. null = nothing to bump (tag is the only version).

frontendVersionBumpCmd.description: Optional shell command to bump the frontend version instead of a direct JSON edit. '{version}' is replaced with the numeric version (no leading 'v'). Run from the directory of frontendVersionFile. e.g. 'bun pm version {version} --no-git-tag-version'.

gate.description: Verification commands. Run from repo root.

phase1.description: Fail-fast check before cutting the release branch (Standard Phase 1). Defaults to 'mandatory' if omitted.

mandatory.description: The blocking gate: Standard Phase 2, Quick release, and Hotfix. A failure stops the release (no PR/MR, no merge).

ciTriggerNote.description: One sentence describing when CI runs, shown in the Phase 2 gate section. e.g. '.github/workflows/release.yml triggers on tag push; CI runs after the tag, there is no PR CI'.

modes.description: Enabled workflows. 'standard' and 'hotfix' are the usual pair; add 'quick' to allow dev -> main in one pass.
